note: SCOPE_1.7.2 §4.3 — the cross-platform status contract. Android and iOS must both produce and consume exactly these. E1 exists because a silent divergence here is invisible until a real group is riding: one platform would render nothing where the other renders 'Need help'.

codes.note: unknown message — must render at the correct severity, never be dropped
unknown persona — must not blank out a valid alert
digit 0 is reserved for a tier ABOVE alert and must still demote to INFO: an unrecognised tier must never make an old client scream
leading whitespace — the wire is ours end to end, so padding has no legitimate source

ages.note: the ordinary case — transit plus how long the sender had held it
a position stamped fractionally after the relay read its own clock is fresh, not future
reboot — the sender kept the status but lost its age. Age is UNKNOWN, never fabricated, and never zero, which would claim it was set this instant
a negative age from a broken sender clamps rather than travelling

buckets.note: the Now threshold tracks the relay's ADVERTISED cadence, not a constant — the relay slows everyone down under load and a fixed threshold would make the whole fleet start counting seconds during a legitimate slowdown
